raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

When the text before the first tool-call marker arrives in the **same
streaming delta** as the call itself, `BaseFormatDetector` drops it. The
increment starts parsing at `current_text.find(self.bot_token)`, and when the
call completes the buffer is reset to the remainder *after* the JSON — the
prefix is never emitted as `normal_text`.

Multi-token deltas make this the common case, not an edge case: a larger
`--stream-interval` (documented as the throughput knob) and speculative
decoding / MTP batch several tokens per delta. Reproduced offline with
`FunctionCallParser` on current `main`:

```python
# one delta: 'Sure! <tool_call>\n{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "SF"}}\n</tool_call>'
# streaming: normal_text=''        <- 'Sure!' silently dropped
# detect_and_parse: normal_text='Sure!', one complete call
```

`KimiK2Detector` already drains text before its start token as normal text
(`_locate_tool_call_start`); the shared base detector does not, so every
detector relying on `BaseFormatDetector.parse_streaming_increment` (e.g.
`qwen25`) loses the prose.

## Modifications

- `BaseFormatDetector.parse_streaming_increment`: at the entry of the
  tool-call branch, if a non-whitespace prefix precedes the **first**
  `bot_token`, trim it into the result's `normal_text` and process the call in
  the same increment (single bounded recursion — after the trim, `bot_pos ==
  0`).
- Scoped to `current_tool_id == -1`, so markup between later calls stays
  suppressed and cannot leak into content.
- Whitespace-only prefixes keep the old drop behavior, so constrained
  pure-JSON output (`JsonArrayParser`, `tool_choice="required"`) gains no
  content chunks — covered by a dedicated test.
- Detectors with custom streaming (deepseekv3, glm, kimik2, ...) are
  unaffected; `finish()` behavior is unchanged.

## Tests

Offline unit tests (no server, no model loading), added to the existing
classes:

- `TestQwen25Detector.test_streaming_prefix_text_arriving_with_tool_call`:
  prose + call in one delta streams `Sure! ` and the complete call.
- `TestQwen25Detector.test_streaming_whitespace_only_prefix_stays_unstreamed`:
  whitespace-only prefix produces no content chunk.
- `TestQwen25Detector.test_streaming_inter_call_markup_not_streamed_as_content`:
  markup between two calls does not leak into streamed content.
- `TestJsonArrayParser.test_whitespace_prefix_before_array_stays_unstreamed`:
  constrained pure-JSON output keeps the old behavior.

The full `test/registered/unit/function_call/` suite was run against both
unmodified `main` and this branch: identical results apart from the new tests
(561 → 565 passed, the 4 pre-existing environment-bound failures and 18
xgrammar-stub errors unchanged) — no regressions.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A: no user-facing option changed)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A: pure parsing-logic fix, no kernel/model-forward changes)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

cc @JustinTong0323 (function_call codeowner). Independent of #47606 (same
module, different function); both can merge in either order.

@@ -168,6 +168,20 @@ def parse_streaming_increment(
         if not hasattr(self, "_tool_indices"):
             self._tool_indices = self._get_tool_indices(tools)
 
+        # Text before the first bot_token must reach the client even when it
+        # arrives in the same delta as the tool call: a larger --stream-interval
+        # or speculative decoding batches several tokens per delta. Only the
+        # first call's prefix is drained (it is user-visible prose); markup
+        # between later calls stays suppressed. Whitespace-only prefixes keep
+        # the old drop behavior so constrained pure-JSON output is unaffected.
+        if self.current_tool_id == -1:
+            bot_pos = current_text.find(self.bot_token)
+            if bot_pos > 0 and current_text[:bot_pos].strip():
+                prefix, self._buffer = current_text[:bot_pos], current_text[bot_pos:]
+                result = self.parse_streaming_increment("", tools)
+                result.normal_text = prefix + result.normal_text
+                return result
+
         flags = Allow.ALL if self.current_tool_name_sent else Allow.ALL & ~Allow.STR
 
         try:

@@ -4092,6 +4092,16 @@ def test_parse_streaming_increment_empty_input(self):
         self.assertEqual(len(result.calls), 0)
         self.assertEqual(result.normal_text, "")
 
+    def test_whitespace_prefix_before_array_stays_unstreamed(self):
+        """Whitespace before the constrained JSON array gains no content
+        chunk; the first-call prefix drain only applies to real prose."""
+        detector = JsonArrayParser()
+        result = detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+            '\n[{"name": "get_weather", "parameters": {"location": "Tokyo"}}]',
+            self.tools,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(result.normal_text, "")
+
     def test_finish_streams_arguments_of_calls_completed_in_final_chunk(self):
         """Calls that arrive whole in the last chunk still stream their
         arguments at stream end, exactly once."""
@@ -5579,6 +5589,61 @@ def test_streaming_multiple_tool_calls_char_by_char_separator(self):
         cities = [json.loads(result[i]["parameters"])["city"] for i in sorted(result)]
         self.assertEqual(cities, ["NYC", "LA"])
 
+    def test_streaming_prefix_text_arriving_with_tool_call(self):
+        """Prose that arrives in the same delta as the tool call it precedes
+        (multi-token deltas: larger --stream-interval, speculative decoding)
+        must still reach the client instead of being swallowed."""
+        chunks = [
+            'Sure! <tool_call>\n{"name": "get_current_weather", ',
+            '"arguments": {"city": "NYC", "state": "NY", "unit": "celsius"}}',
+            "\n</tool_call>",
+        ]
+        content = ""
+        result = {}
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            parsed = self.detector.parse_streaming_increment(chunk, self.tools)
+            content += parsed.normal_text
+            for call in parsed.calls:
+                entry = result.setdefault(
+                    call.tool_index, {"name": "", "parameters": ""}
+                )
+                if call.name:
+                    entry["name"] = call.name
+                if call.parameters:
+                    entry["parameters"] += call.parameters
+
+        self.assertEqual(content, "Sure! ")
+        self.assertEqual(result[0]["name"], "get_current_weather")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            json.loads(result[0]["parameters"]),
+            {"city": "NYC", "state": "NY", "unit": "celsius"},
+        )
+
+    def test_streaming_whitespace_only_prefix_stays_unstreamed(self):
+        """A whitespace-only prefix before the bot_token keeps the old drop
+        behavior so constrained pure-JSON output gains no content chunks."""
+        parsed = self.detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+            '\n<tool_call>\n{"name": "get_current_weather", '
+            '"arguments": {"city": "NYC", "state": "NY", "unit": "celsius"}}'
+            "\n</tool_call>",
+            self.tools,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(parsed.normal_text, "")
+
+    def test_streaming_inter_call_markup_not_streamed_as_content(self):
+        """Markup between two tool calls must not leak into the streamed
+        content now that first-call prefixes are drained as text."""
+        call1 = '<tool_call>\n{"name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": {"city": "NYC", "state": "NY", "unit": "celsius"}}\n</tool_call>'
+        call2 = '<tool_call>\n{"name": "get_current_weather", "arguments": {"city": "LA", "state": "CA", "unit": "celsius"}}\n</tool_call>'
+        content = ""
+        for chunk in ["Sure! ", call1 + call2]:
+            content += self.detector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                chunk, self.tools
+            ).normal_text
+
+        self.assertEqual(content, "Sure! ")
+        self.assertNotIn("</tool_call>", content)
+
